name: having_null_drops_group
query: SELECT account, count(*) AS n WHERE account ~ '^Assets:US:(Vanguard|Hoogle|ETrade)' GROUP BY account HAVING max(payee) < 'I' ORDER BY account
notes: max(payee) is NULL for the accounts whose postings have no payee, so the comparison is NULL and the group is dropped, like a false HAVING value. Only the two accounts with payee 'Hoogle' remain.
